section.heading: Notification and record-keeping requirements.

para.text: A covered employer subject to this chapter shall notify each subcontractor in writing of the prevailing wage requirements.
Covered employers and subcontractors subject to this chapter shall:

Retain payroll records created and maintained in the regular course of business under District of Columbia law for a period of at least 3 years or the prevailing federal standard at the time the record is created, whichever is greater; and
Acknowledge and abide by the rights of employees under the National Labor Relations Act (29 U.S.C. § 157).

section.codify:annotation: Section 7 of D.C. Law 25-274 provided that D.C. Law 25-274 shall apply 180 day after its applicability date.

Applicability of D.C. Law 25-274: § 8 of D.C. Law 25-274 provided that the creation of this section by § 4 of D.C. Law 25-274 is subject to the inclusion of the law’s fiscal effect in an approved budget and financial plan. Therefore that amendment has not been implemented.
